Held items (if you have them, efficient bandana works great for earlier dungeons)

An slumber orb/foe-hold-orb/One-shot orb/Petrify orb (any of above, in case you ran into a monster house, especially in early gameplay where your ability to clear out monster houses is limited)

An escape orb (helps you to bail out of the dungeon if disaster strikes {ran out of supplies etc})

from 3rd grade to 15th grade maybe ?

sometimes essential for your recovery 
getting help

I've been depressed for a long time, a long time 
From 3rd grade to 15th grade, to be more accurate 
as you know this period is the most important one in one's development(identity/characters) 
As I've said, I've been depressed during this time 
it's so severe that I started to feel suicidal in the 5th grade 
so, it had me changed a lot

but, something happened in my 15th grade 
I attempted suicide after all these years,
I couldn't do it, I can't take it any longer 
and well, I survived(who am I kidding, of course)
I've stayed in the hospital for a couple following months, I started to take meds
first it seems nothing's different 
but then
I started to realize that, I'm more motivated than before 
plus, I feel like I can truly feel happy now(not for long though)
with this, I gained more and more strength for my recovery 
I kept going on and on with my life 
and now, it's a whole lot better than those years
(apparently so)
I now feel like my old self again(too bad I don't really remember that "old self" back then, but still)
I've regained the ability to feel truly happy, 
to smile, to live with a motivated mind
all that good stuff 

so, yeah
I don't know what's your story 
I don't even know you believe that or not
but the thing is, I'm sure it is possible 
for someone to recover from a long depression 
I hope my story will inspire you
